decisions.why: Image-analysis software, not a lab analyser. Confirmed 13/09/2026: listed on 3dhistech.com's own software index under Image Analysis, described as a repository of image-analysis tools for quantifying tissue structures and IHC/CISH/FISH staining, called up from CaseViewer/SlideViewer. Sysmex UK distributes 3DHISTECH's digital pathology range; this named product sits in the otherwise wholly-unmapped 'Products Detail' bucket alongside genuine hardware analysers, which stay unmapped. Fits digital:sw ('clinical and departmental software systems').

Web-based database/repository for digitised pathology slides, not a lab analyser. Confirmed 13/09/2026: listed on 3dhistech.com's own software index; described (via Sysmex's own SlideViewer page) as the destination scanned slides are uploaded to, 'a web-based database for your digitized tissue sections that can be accessed from any location'. Sits in the same otherwise wholly-unmapped 'Products Detail' bucket. Fits digital:sw.

Digital pathology viewing application. Confirmed 13/09/2026 on 3dhistech.com/software/slide-viewer/: 'SlideViewer is software, not hardware... a digital microscope application designed for viewing and analyzing pathology slides', with whole-slide viewing, annotation and remote-collaboration features. Sits in the same otherwise wholly-unmapped 'Products Detail' bucket. Fits digital:sw. ('Slidedriver', the fourth software-sounding name in the same bucket, was checked and left held: it is a physical USB stage-control peripheral, not software, and was not force-mapped.)
